people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: But it is not as though the word of God has come to nothing. For they are not all Israel that are of Israel.
translations.bsb: It is not as though God’s word has failed. For not all who are descended from Israel are Israel.
translations.kjv: Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect. For they are not all Israel, which are of Israel:
translations.asv: But it is not as though the word of God hath come to nought. For they are not all Israel, that are of Israel:
